Confusing policy debate (WHAT) with personal identity attacks (WHO). This is a bait-and-switch replacing platform with vitriol.

Instead of transparently debating policy, the campaign used projection and personal attacks to manufacture conflict and capture attention.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. F_neg dominates via aggressive polarization.

The Unavoidable Truth: Personal attacks obscure substantive debate on critical policy issues.

The Unavoidable Lie: These provocative jabs constitute brave populist pushback.
